== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Water [[aura]] is a spiritual energy that can manifest in various forms, ranging from a pale green liquid [[madra]] fused with venom and death to ocean-blue tides capable of crushing [[stone]]. It is often perceived through [[Spiritual sight|spiritual sight]] as blue, blue-green, or white and can be used to create physical effects such as waves, bubbles, or liquid-like environments. This energy can be manipulated through techniques to control actual [[water]], create protective cushions, or even allow creatures to swim through the air. When concentrated, it can act as a powerful suppressant against the soul or be used to bolster [[Life aura|life aura]]. While it can behave like a choppy sea when supporting certain objects, it also possesses the ability to prevent flames from spreading. In some instances, [[water]] [[aura]] can be combined with other energies, such as [[dream aura]], to create harmonious flows of power.}}
